✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of GFT Group is eligible and may be installed.

✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between GFT Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a GFT Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,

✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a GFB Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base GFB Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e.viruses and malware)
? Install and execute any licensable software that is not free of charge and not provided or authorized by the GFB/IT Infrastructure Department with the exception of trial software that should only be used for evaluation purposes

✔️ Only personnel from GFT Group may request LAR privileges.

✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base GFT Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e.viruses and malware)
? Install and execute any licensable software that is not free of charge and not provided or authorized by the GFT/IT Infrastructure Department with the exception of trial software

✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

? Alter the base GHT Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.

? Install and execute any licensable software that is not free of charge and not provided or authorized by the GHT/IT Infrastructure Department with the exception of trial software that should only be used for evaluation purposes

- General Instructions:
Please provide the full name of your ABC employee manager (L6 or above). If they are unavailable, please provide an alternative contact to complete this request.

Below you will find the computers Group IT has already assigned to you, the available names may not match the one on the label of your PC.

To identify your computer name pls check the Device Name in the company portal application or open a cmd command window and write hostname.

If your PC is not in the list, please ensure to select Not in the list (PC) and place the name of your computer in the Other Computer Name field, in that case, ensure to fill that field.

Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for the harming integrity of your working device, ABC & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, as changing system settings, installing system-level software or steal confidential information, like passwords.

- Additional information:
Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for the harming integrity of your working device, XYO & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, such as changing system settings, installing system-level software, or stealing confidential information like passwords.

Permanent admin rights should only be requested if you need it for regular repeating tasks for daily business (please provide reason in ticket request, it will not be approved without proper justification).
Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

Hi,

with the latest version of Java, the_home variable doesn't point to the correct java installation.

I also need to change MAVEN_HOME quite frequently to work on several projects that require different versions of Maven.

Can I please have permanent admin rights on my PC to avoid opening a ticket every time?

Thank you!
- Important Information:
The provided local admin rights will require to be renewed after 12 months after the approval. A new request will be required at that time if those rights are still needed.
- XYO Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base XYO Group system installations.

✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,

✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:

Hello,

For regular development activities, please request **Long-Term Local Administrator Rights** through the administrator-rights request form. The request requires justification and manager approval.

Please provide the following information:

- Full name of your employee manager (**L6 or above**), or an alternative approver. If you are L6 or above, provide your own name.
- Computer name/device name and operating system. You can find the device name in the Company Portal or by running `hostname` in Command Prompt.
- Clients and projects you support.
- The specific development tools, software, and administrative actions requiring elevated permissions, including the need to modify environment variables.
- Confirmation that your manager has checked the applicable client requirements.

Please note that local administrator access is a security risk and may only be used for approved business-related software and tasks. It must not be used to alter the base system installation, disable security services, or install unauthorized/licensed software. Approved access is valid for **12 months** and must then be renewed if still required.

Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base GFT Group system installations.

✔️ Only personnel from GFT Group may request LAR privileges.

✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base GFT Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages

feedback.answer:
Hello,

Because you require administrator privileges for recurring tasks—such as modifying system variables and the Windows hosts file—this should be submitted as a **Long-Term Local Administrator Rights** request, subject to approval.

Please provide the following information:

- Full name of your GFT manager or approver at **Level L6 or above**. If you are L6 or above, provide your own name.
- Your computer name. You can find it in the Company Portal under **Device Name**, or by running `hostname` in Command Prompt.
- Operating system.
- Clients and projects you support.
- Detailed justification, including the administrative actions and any software/tools requiring elevated privileges.
- Confirmation that your manager has verified the request does not conflict with any client contract requirements.

Please note that permanent local administrator access increases security risks and is granted only where required for regular business activities. Approved rights must be renewed after **12 months**. Any software installed using these privileges must be authorized and related to GFT business needs; security protections and the base workstation configuration must not be altered.
